faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and tooling cost for FS-110 Machine Spirit Torsion-Spring 14-Magnet N50 Mecha Slider?

faqs.question: Can we customize our corporate or brand logo on FS-110?
faqs.answer: Yes. Note that our factory does NOT recommend surface silk-screen or UV ink printing on metal because smooth, chemically inert metal surfaces lack ink adhesion and peel off under thumb friction. Instead, we recommend two permanent methods on FS-110: (1) 50W Fiber Laser Engraving for monochrome logos (+$0.15–$0.30/pc, $0 setup, 100 pcs MOQ, $50 USD sample fee), and (2) Deep Laser Engraving + Color Fill for colored logos (+$0.35–$0.60/pc, 100–200 pcs MOQ, $80–$150 USD sample fee), where the laser carves a recessed cavity filled with cured enamel so the color never peels.

faqs.answer: All magnetic and mechanical assemblies (14 pcs , 4*1.5MM,N50; 1 pcs Hardened Dowel Pin Ø2*4MM,4 pcs Hardened Steel Detent Ball 3MM,1 pcs Hex Socket Screw M3*8.8Thread Length 5mm, 6 pcs Hex Socket Screw M2*7.6Thread Length 6mm, 1 pcs Precision Coil Spring 5*36*0.4Wire Ø18 Coils , 1 pcs Torsion Spring 3.5*9.2*0.5Wire Ø7 Coils) are structurally enclosed or mechanically locked using industrial two-part structural epoxy (>22 MPa shear strength) and thread-locked fasteners, passing 10× 1.5m concrete drop abuse tests under US CPSC 16 CFR Part 1262 and EU RoHS 3 / REACH directives.
